result.document_summary: Massachusetts General Laws c. 186 § 11, which sets a 14-day notice to quit for nonpayment of rent under a written lease and a right to cure by paying rent due, interest and costs.
result.notes: This section governs termination of a lease for nonpayment of rent. It is a notice-and-cure procedure for nonpayment and does not list allowed eviction causes, relocation assistance, or coverage in the way a just-cause eviction regime does, and it contains no rule in any of the other in-scope categories. It is therefore not recorded as a just_cause_eviction rule. No rules are extracted.
